runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and competitors derived by the analyst from the 10-K; the name has no current SEC filings (registration revoked), so the last filed 10-K and 10-Q stood as the primary record and the analyst was told to take nothing later from aggregators. Price **none found** (registration revoked 2022-08-18, Release No. 95549, accession 9999999997-22-003981; the company's site posts nothing after 2019; OTC Markets and Yahoo, aggregators, flagged, returned nothing) x **87,145,235 common shares** (10-Q cover, 2019-11-22, accession 0001493152-19-018289; 83,195,939 on the 2019-09-30 balance sheet, 1,283,791 traced to the 8-K 0001493152-19-016780, 2,665,505 untraced) = cap none; sovereign **5.37%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-28). Filings: 10-K FY2018 0001493152-19-005266, 10-K FY2016 0001302946-17-000019, 10-K FY2017 0001493152-18-004893, the 10-Q above, DEF 14A 0001493152-18-014269, 8-Ks 0001493152-19-016780, 0001493152-20-005339, 0001493152-20-007292, 0001493152-21-016792. tools/run.py and Screens/cover_shares.py found no live SEC ticker; every figure from the filed statements, the 2012 to 2017 balance sheets from tagged data, labelled. **Q1 OUT**: a start-up in substance, read by earning power rather than age, said so; four businesses begun since 2009 (irrigated farming, the produce business sold after "three years of operational losses", greenhouse leasing to marijuana growers deconsolidated 2018, water management called the core business from 2016 with "negligible" revenue) and CBD hemp entities bought in July 2019 wholly for 30,000,000 shares; revenue $66K in 2018; net cash from operations negative every year 2012 to 2018; accumulated deficit $95.596M at 2019-09-30; the Cucharas dam razed by the State in January 2019 for want of the company's capital, a rebuild obligation of about $40M (8-K 0001493152-20-007292) against cash of $401K; no periodic report after the 10-Q for 2019-09-30, the FY2019 10-K promised for May 2020 never filed, the revocation by default. Alternative reading TOO HARD (WORK or NATURE) on the missing accounts, declared. Q2 to Q12 NOT REACHED. Balance sheet: cash $2.1M to $6K and current liabilities $3.1M to about $21M from 2012 to 2018 as the HCIC seller notes defaulted; common equity negative 2016 to 2018; the 2018 profit a non-cash $12.8M deconsolidation gain; 2019 equity restored by $14.1M of goodwill on the hemp share issue; shares 26.5M (2014) to 87.1M (2019). Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: over $81M raised since inception; a 2018 contempt motion naming the company, its directors and its former CEO; stock pay $888K in the MD&A against $3.0M in the cash-flow statement; a misprinted total-assets figure in the 10-Q; 2019 convertible notes at 70% of the lowest price over ten days. Competitors: the 10-K names none; not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after all spending -$9,243K (2015), -$6,686K (2016), -$4,691K (2017), -$4,223K (2018), average -$6,211K after interest, -$5,346K before; 2014 not completed (FY2014 10-K not read); negative every year; specific (b), the no-growth case alone; net debt $9.796M at 2019-09-30 with $4.988M of preferred distributions payable shown beside; value about -$1.25 a share all-equity and -$1.33 equity-only at the sovereign; at ten percent -$0.73 all-equity, -$0.71 equity-only; fair price reported as none. Could not get: any price; any filing or company disclosure after July 2021; whether the 2020 sale of the HCIC stake closed; whether the hemp business operates; the source of 2,665,505 cover shares. Framework gaps for the operator: start-up undefined by age or earning power; no stated treatment for a name that has stopped filing; no rule for reporting a negative fair price. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, 13 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB; raw filings in the ignored cache. Contamination declared: WATR commit subjects and the memory index; none names TURV, none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1: a Colorado water-rights and farming company that never reached a year of positive operating cash in four businesses, its key dam razed by the State for want of capital, CBD hemp bought for stock in 2019, then silent until the SEC revoked its registration in 2022; no price found; computation only, owner cash negative every year, value about -$1.25 a share. Not armed.
